description: For service quote, this checklist records deliverables, exclusions, responsibilities, service levels, implementation, recurring fees, pass-through costs, and options. Its supporting evidence includes discovery notes, cost model, rate card, supplier inputs, exception approvals, scope attachment, and version comparison.

Complete the applicable handoff for approved quote version, customer delivery, acceptance status, expiry follow-up, CRM update, and contract handoff.
